title: GKS Application Overview
subtitle: Embassy vs University Track + Live Q&A
description: Embassy track or university track? Learn how the GKS routes differ, what the official call requires, how to approach university selection and documents, and what successful preparation looks like.
mentorHeading: Learn from someone who has already done it.
mentorBio: I am pursuing an M.Sc. in Computer Vision & AI at Yeungnam University (YU). I am a Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) scholar funded by NIIED, with additional support from the RLRC & RISE industry-collaboration projects.
My research focuses on 3D computer vision & spatial intelligence, 6D pose estimation, vision-language-action (VLA) models, world models, and agentic robotics for robot manipulation.
outcomesHeading: After 90 minutes, you will have a clearer plan
